statement: Better art added for the grasslands in world one
New damage number display for hits of 10 million plus damage in one hit
Attack talents now have a larger top left edge border so attacks are distinguishable from passive talents
Arcade shop description now shows which bonus rotation is active and how rotation changes each update and keeps previous bonuses
Added insta lab flower followers? to all world 3 monsters and rare drop tables
Grand Frogger and Eldritch Frog cards are now passive and give percent chance to start with RNG items
Talent library now auto selects your overall class instead of always showing warrior first
Anvil crafting recipes start with equipment filter in the top left corner making equip crafting easier to navigate
When choosing talent books in the library your current max level of the talent now shows
Added dungeon shop in the NPC shop where you can buy things with dungeon credits
If you disconnect or crash during a dungeon run your dungeon passes are refunded
After a disconnect refund you keep no dungeon credits or flurbos earned during that run
Birthday cards have a new description
New secret reading glasses accessory added in game
Cauldron boost now maxes at level 170 and anyone above 170 is reduced to 170
Added storage chest 14 to the middle desert rare drop table
Added storage chests 22 and 23 to world 4 mobs
Boosted drop chance for inventory bag G by 1.5x
Added more storage chest space to the gem shop
More jump trap purchases added to gem shop?
Fixed bug where blobfish critters disappeared after being unlocked
Fixed graphical issue where VIP library showed up visually without any VIP membership unlocked
Overwhelming golden egg pet breeding upgrade now correctly gives its bonus and the bonus numbers changed slightly
Fixed talent reset potion or star talent potion also resetting the other talent presets
Party Starter wizard talent now has a working second bonus giving attack speed or damage
Fixed frog dungeon desync where other players' eldritch rib cages did not count for others
World 4 carries are now available in the shop
Fixed TPP star talent staying at max level zero regardless of boosts; retroactively fixes itself
Death Note kill count no longer goes wrong on mobile at about 2 billion kills
Fixed inconsistency where the 10th player did not give sigil XP when placed in sigils
Journeyman plus luck family bonus now correctly applies its bonus to all characters
Idol skilling talent now correctly gives plus AFK gain rate for cooking
Tempestuous Emotions talent now correctly gives plus percent skill effect for cooking
Fishing XP per hour AFK info fixed to reflect actual XP per hour
Journeyman piggy bank talent no longer visually messes up void plus coins on the ground
Lustre bug catching net now shows as green instead of the incorrect purple
World 2 constellation counter now correctly counts all 8 constellations instead of showing 7 of 8
Fixed rarity upgrade display for pet breeding showing a weird number with the gilded shells achievement
Construction HUD building bars no longer show for empty spaces only above actual unlocked projects
Fixed XP and pet enemy fight HP and cauldron boosted displays beyond 1 trillion
Fixed percent chance for two times ladles post office bonus not correctly doubling ladles when triggered
Picked spawn point on Still to Seekers map the last mob in world 4
No bubble left behind lab bonus description now says you must play each day to get plus one bubble levels
World 3 and 4 mini boss respawn progression no longer requires logging in daily; days away still count
Alchemy player info now says sigil if player is assigned to a sigil instead of nal
Bonus pet damage in arena pet battles now works properly
Previously ignored pet damage bonuses from meals vials achievements and the beast master talent now apply
Plus percent cooking efficiency equipment bonus notably from cooking rings now correctly applied
Massive fig meal now correctly gives its bonus
American Tipper star talent description no longer says it isn't additive with other bonuses as it never was
Black diamond rhinestone no longer applies the lining bonus to avoid fringe case disconnects; still applies every other food bonus
Kilroy's speech box now closes automatically when you open other menus to avoid accidental interaction
Fixed lab two-times stamp bonus not working until swapping characters; now works instantly on opening the game
